Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high‑quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.

As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil‑based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function – including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. title: Operador de Maquina de Lavar
description:
Descrição da vaga

A OSID – Obras Sociais Irmã Dulce é uma das maiores instituições filantrópicas do país, com cerca de 5,6 milhões de procedimentos ambulatoriais por ano, na Bahia, a usuários do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), idosos, pessoas com deficiência e com deformidades craniofaciais, pessoas em situação de rua, usuários de substâncias psicoativas e crianças e adolescentes em situação de risco social.

A entidade conta com um perfil de serviços único no Brasil, distribuídos em 21 núcleos que prestam assistência à população de baixa renda nas áreas de Saúde, Assistência Social, Pesquisa Científica, Ensino em Saúde, Educação e na preservação e difusão da história de sua fundadora, Santa Dulce dos Pobres.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Coletar roupa suja nos expurgos das diversas unidades (Complexo Roma), utilizando carros fechados, encaminhando para a área suja do CPR, triando para serem processadas (conforme automatização dos processos instalados na máquina de lavar). Pesando e registrando em formulário “Coleta de Roupa por Unidade” viabilizando o lançamento no relatório orçamentário.
  • Processar roupa suja em máquinas de lavar industrial, observando a orientação técnica programada pelo fornecedor para cada tipo de processo, obedecendo também a capacidade e o manuseio dos equipamentos.
  • Operar os equipamentos da área limpa (Máquina de lavar, Centrifuga, Secador, Calandra) conforme orientação do fabricante e treinamento no que diz respeito à capacidade e programação.
  • Acondicionar roupa na centrífuga obedecendo as orientações técnicas, para conservar e manter a integridade do tecido.
  • Triar roupas processadas separando para tratamento específico, como: relavagem, tratamentos químicos de manchas (oleosas e graxas).
  • Encaminhar peças do enxoval que precisem de reparo para a costuraria, garantido a boa apresentação do enxoval.
  • Arrumar kits de roupas conforme padronização estabelecida, distribuindo nos armários ou rouparias das unidades internas devidamente protocolados, garantido o bom atendimento do serviço.
  • Montar LAP cirúrgico conforme padrão estabelecido, garantindo o bom andamento do procedimento.
  • Serigrafar todo o enxoval com a logomarca da Instituição, identificando, para controle e padronização.
  • Fazer limpeza diária das gavetas dos secadores e tanque séptico para absorção de fuligens (ductos), garantindo o bom desempenho do equipamento e segurança do trabalhador.
  • Receber materiais e equipamentos do almoxarifado conferindo a nota fiscal garantindo a quantidade recebida.
  • Encaminhar semanalmente os carros de transporte de roupa para manutenção preventiva das rodas, garantido o bom funcionamento e evitando doenças ocupacionais.
  • Usar equipamentos de proteção individual para evitar contaminação, conforme orientação da liderança e do profissional da segurança do trabalho, mantendo-os higienizados (IT CPR 08 Higienização dos Equipamentos de Proteção Individual) após uso e acondicionados em sacos plásticos fechados.
  • Participar das elaborações das Instruções de trabalhos pertinentes a área, contribuindo para o programa de qualidade.
  • Participar de treinamentos técnicos garantindo a atualização de conhecimentos na área de processamento de roupas.
  • Participar de reunião administrativa convocada pela liderança.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • 06 meses de experiência em cargos similares.

Informações adicionais

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Almoço no refeitório.

We use Claude Code CLI, Claude Cowork with MCP connectors, OpenClaw, n8n, VAPI, and custom multi-agent systems to eliminate manual work across every layer of our operations — from creator sourcing and outreach to content production, team coordination, and client delivery.

THE MISSION: REPLACE MANUAL WORK WITH AI AGENTS

ContentJet is on a mission to become a fully AI-native agency. That means every workflow that currently requires a human clicking, copying, pasting, searching, emailing, or following up manually should be handled by an AI agent instead. We’re not looking for someone to build chatbots — we’re looking for someone who can systematically identify manual bottlenecks across our operations and replace them with autonomous agent systems that run 24/7 without human intervention.

This includes: creator discovery and vetting, outreach campaign creation, brief reading and task assignment, content pipeline management, quality control, reporting, team notifications, client communication, and any repetitive operational task that currently eats human hours.

THE ROLE

You are the person who designs and builds complete AI agent systems from concept to production. You will own the architecture of multi-agent pipelines — defining agent roles, communication flows, tool integrations, and orchestration logic.

You will work extensively with Claude Code CLI to build, test, and iterate on agent systems directly from the terminal — writing production-grade code, managing project structures, and leveraging Claude’s coding capabilities for rapid development. You will use Claude Cowork with MCP connectors to orchestrate complex workflows that read from Monday.com, discover creators on TikTok/Modash, create Instantly campaigns, produce personalized documents, and coordinate across Slack channels — all without manual intervention.

You will deploy agents via OpenClaw, our open-source AI agent gateway, to make them accessible across multiple platforms (Slack, Telegram, web) with full DM and group chat support, tool management, and multi-model routing.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Systematically audit ContentJet’s operations to identify every manual task that can be replaced by an AI agent or automation
  • Design and build multi-agent systems that fully replace manual workflows: creator sourcing, outreach, qualification, brief processing, campaign management, reporting, and team coordination

  • Build complex automation workflows using Claude Cowork with MCP connectors — orchestrating Monday.com, TikTok, Modash, Instantly, Google Drive, Slack, and other platforms into seamless, zero-touch pipelines

  • Build AI-powered creator sourcing and outreach pipelines — from Monday.com brief reading through creator discovery to Instantly campaign creation, with personalized Word document guides produced automatically for team members
  • Build AI voice agents using VAPI + Claude + Twilio/Telnyx for creator and lead qualification, replacing manual phone screening
  • Write production-grade Python agent code with proper error handling, logging, Slack integration (multi-channel), and monitoring
  • Design prompt systems at the systems level — agent instructions, OpenClaw tool configurations, Claude Cowork task definitions, output parsing, and quality control
  • Create CLAUDE.md project files for agent codebases following enterprise-grade standards (security, design philosophy, code organization)
  • Continuously look for new manual processes to automate — the goal is zero manual work for repetitive tasks

MUST-HAVE SKILLS

  • Python (production-level, not just scripting) — you write code that runs in production 24/7
  • Deep prompt engineering — system-level agent instructions, multi-step reasoning chains, tool-use orchestration, not simple chatbot prompts
  • Claude Code CLI proficiency — comfortable building, testing, and shipping entire projects from the terminal using Claude as a coding partner
  • Claude Cowork experience — ability to design and execute complex multi-step workflows using MCP connectors to orchestrate across platforms
  • Experience with OpenClaw or similar AI agent gateways/orchestration frameworks for multi-platform agent deployment
  • API integration experience (REST, webhooks, OAuth, API chaining) — you can wire any two systems together
  • Experience building multi-agent or multi-step AI systems (CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph, or custom builds)
  • Strong understanding of MCP (Model Context Protocol) — how to connect Claude to external tools, databases, and services
  • Understanding of agent design patterns: ReAct, tool-use, delegation, human-in-the-loop, autonomous decision-making
  • Experience deploying agents across multiple platforms (Slack bots, Telegram bots, web chat)
  • Strong English communication (written) — you’ll write agent specs, workflow documentation, and team guides

NICE-TO-HAVE

  • Familiarity with n8n (self-hosted) for workflow automation alongside agent systems
  • Background in UGC, creator economy, influencer marketing, or content operations
  • Experience with Monday.com API, Modash, TikTok Creator Marketplace, or similar creator tools
  • Experience configuring OpenClaw for multi-platform deployment with tool availability management and config troubleshooting
  • French or Arabic language skills (for MENA market projects)

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within 30 days: You’ve audited our current manual workflows, deployed your first multi-agent system via OpenClaw integrated with Slack, and shipped a working creator sourcing automation using Claude Cowork with MCP connectors.

Within 60 days: You’ve replaced at least 3 major manual workflows with autonomous agent systems. You’re independently designing agent architectures using Claude Code CLI and deploying them via OpenClaw with minimal direction.

Within 90 days: You’re leading AI agent delivery across 3–5 concurrent automation projects, have eliminated the majority of repetitive manual tasks in our operations, and are training team members on agent-powered workflows. Manual work at ContentJet is the exception, not the norm.

mybest is one of Japan's largest product comparison platforms.

You will work directly with the mybest Brazil Country Manager to successfully launch the sales unit.

You will be selling PR placements, including banner and dedicated PR frames for brand promotion, on

One Japanese Country Manager working in Japan time, and one Brazilian supervisor working in local São Paulo time.

  • Professional-level English or Japanese for communicating with the Japanese Country Manager (Strong writing skills are not required, as long as verbal communication is sufficient)

What We're Looking For

A future sales leader with the drive to build and grow a sales business from the ground up.

7,500 BRL ~ 12,000 BRL per month plus 5% commission on sales

*Salary is determined based on experience.

*A 3-month trial period applies to this position.

*All travel expenses will be covered by the company.

Location and Work Style

Fully remote

*We value the number of client conversations and closed deals over hours worked.

Curtiu? Candidate-se e venha para o nosso time!

Mais do que casas, queremos construir respostas. Já somos mais de 30 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos, engajados na busca por um futuro melhor para todos e todas.

Acreditamos que diversidade e inclusão são componentes essenciais para o crescimento da sociedade, além de serem fatores essenciais para a sustentabilidade do nosso negócio. Queremos estimular um ambiente seguro, diverso e inclusivo em que todas as pessoas tenham oportunidades iguais para crescer e evoluir. Para chegar lá, nossas ações são voltadas para garantir a:

• Equidade de gêneros ⚧

Transformar a sociedade é um grande desafio. Mas, juntos, é possível. Faça parte de um grupo com o olhar para o futuro, mas que acredita que as transformações que queremos para o amanhã devem começar hoje.

Soft Skills

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award‑winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.

Syniti’s cloud‑native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high‑impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI‑driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge‑case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.

WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud‑native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large‑scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI‑native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO‑certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi‑time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.

Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.

Our Core Values

Think Big – Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious – Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action – Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together – Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.

OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.

Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.

Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.

Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .

Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.

Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .

Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
United Hub Digital (UHD) is a nearshore IT consulting firm helping mid and large US enterprise clients accelerate their data and technology initiatives. Headquartered in Greenville, SC, with a delivery hub in Brazil, we embed directly into client teams as a trusted execution partner across data analytics, software development, UI/UX, and project management. We hold ourselves to the same standards of accountability and delivery quality our clients expect from their own teams.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help one of our enterprise clients unlock the value of their data for AI-driven use cases. The goal focus for this role is to 'make the data AI-ready': well-structured, semantically rich, documented, and governed.

Your primary output is a clean, well-documented, and semantically meaningful data environment that downstream AI workloads can reason over reliably.

What You Will Do

Semantic Modeling

  • Design and build semantic layers that translate raw ERP tables into business-meaningful domains (finance, procurement, supply chain, etc.)
  • Define and enforce naming conventions, metric definitions, and business logic in a shared, governed layer
  • Work with Databricks semantic layer to expose curated datasets for AI and analytics consumption

Data Documentation and Context

  • Produce column-level documentation, data dictionaries, and business glossaries inside Unity Catalog
  • Establish lineage tracing from source system tables through to consumption-ready datasets
  • Collaborate with source systems stakeholders to capture domain knowledge and translate it into structured metadata

AI Readiness

  • Structure data to support LLM-based and ML workloads, including RAG pipelines and structured querying
  • Identify and address data quality gaps that would undermine AI model reliability
  • Define thematic data domains and organize datasets to give AI systems the right context and scope

Governance and Quality

  • Implement data quality rules and freshness monitors using Databricks tooling
  • Tag sensitive fields and support data access tier definitions within Unity Catalog
  • Own documentation standards and ensure the catalog remains accurate as data evolves

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering, data architecture, or a closely related discipline
  • Hands-on Databricks expertise: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, cluster configuration, and query optimization
  • Experience with semantic modeling tools, ideally dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud)
  • Strong SQL and a solid understanding of data modeling patterns (star schema, medallion architecture, etc.)
  • Ability to read and interpret unfamiliar data models quickly, including ERP-sourced data structures
  • Experience writing technical documentation that non-technical stakeholders can act on

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Databricks AI/BI, Genie, or Vector Search
  • Experience supporting ML or LLM-based downstream use cases
  • Background in data mesh or domain-oriented data architecture

Data Specialist will design and manage the controls and end‑to‑end process for all master data requirements in Integra, including products, vendors, purchase agreements, employees, and partners. This role ensures master data controls facilitate efficient data migration and high‑volume vendor set‑up requests from all IRC locations, while ensuring that only vendors meeting IRC’s detailed requirements are set up in Integra to allow financial transactions.

The Master Data Management team supports 65 legal entities with data needs within Microsoft D365, requiring a detailed understanding of Master Data concepts, the data management lifecycle, and the technical functionalities of D365.

Major Responsibilities

  • Central point of contact for Master Data, engaging with multiple legal entities to address regular requests, answer questions, resolve data issues, and provide analysis.
  • Perform master data additions, changes and deletions in accordance with standard procedures.
  • Ensure due diligence, required documentation, and all crucial controls are satisfied for vendor data edits, additions and deletion to mitigate risk of non‑compliance, fraud, collusion, and corruption.
  • Authorize and approve requests for master data maintenance.
  • Maintain accurate, up‑to‑date price file management in accordance with current contracts.
  • Conduct quality control activities and recommend or implement additions/changes to Master Data procedures.
  • Review KPIs to ensure data accuracy and that data management policies are effective.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for the day‑to‑day execution of MDM related tasks and guide users on master data processes and business rules.
  • Ensure Purchase Order Contracts meet all requirements prior to issuance to vendors.
  • Create and maintain Master Data related to vendors and products, ensuring high data quality.
  • Monitor Vendors Global address for duplicates and resolve errors to maintain a high standard of data integrity.
  • Improve data consistency for operational and analytical uses.
  • Recommend improvements to processes, procedures, tools, rules, and metrics to ensure data integrity of master data domains.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Science, Technology or Mathematics (STEM) or a business‑related field from a recognized university.
  • Three years of experience as a data analyst, preferably in an international humanitarian organization with strong process and systems understanding.

Demonstrated Skills And Competencies

  • Strong grasp of Microsoft Dynamics 365.
  • Strong analytical skills.

Working Environment

Standard office work environment. Travel less than 10%.

PROFESSIONAL STANDARDS

All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way – Standards for Professional Conduct. These standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, IRC enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to preventive measures and to creating an environment where people feel safe, and to taking necessary corrective actions when harm occurs. SEC convoca mais 600 professores da Educação Básica aprovados em processo seletivo

Os professores convocados atuarão nas unidades escolares da rede estadual de ensino, sob o Regime Especial de Direito Administrativo (Reda).

A Secretaria da Educação do Estado da Bahia (SEC) publicou, nesta quarta-feira (1), no Diário Oficial do Estado, a portaria de convocação de mais 600 candidatos aprovados no Processo Seletivo Simplificado, destinado ao provimento da função de professor da Educação Básica, regido pelo Edital SEC/Sudepe nº 13/2025. Os profissionais convocados atuarão nas unidades escolares da rede estadual de ensino, sob o Regime Especial de Direito Administrativo (Reda).

O vínculo contratual tem duração de 36 meses, podendo ser prorrogado por igual período, com carga horária de 20 horas semanais.

O período para a entrega da documentação é de 6 a 17 de abril, conforme estabelecido na portaria. Os candidatos convocados devem encaminhar os documentos digitalizados para o correio eletrô , a fim de análise preliminar da Coordenação de Provimento e Movimentação (CPM). Entre os documentos exigidos estão diploma de conclusão do curso exigido para a função, documentos pessoais (RG e CPF), comprovante de residência e declaração de não acúmulo de cargos e certidões negativas.

Além do envio eletrônico, os professores convocados devem realizar a entrega presencial da documentação, em original e fotocópia, para conferência. Os aprovados no Núcleo Territorial de Educação (NTE) 26 – Salvador e Região Metropolitana devem comparecer à Secretaria da Educação do Estado da Bahia, localizada na Avenida Luiz Viana Filho, nº 550, 5ª Avenida, Centro Administrativo da Bahia (CAB), 1º andar, sala 117, no horário das 8h30 às 11h e das 14h às 17h. Já os candidatos aprovados para o interior do Estado, às sedes dos Núcleos Territoriais de Educação (NTEs) correspondentes.

O não atendimento à convocação, seja por ausência ou envio incompleto da documentação e/ou fora do prazo estipulado implica na perda do direito ao ingresso na função temporária, independentemente do motivo alegado.

description:
Buscamos um Especialista em Plant Simulation para liderar a criação de gêmeos digitais (Digital Twins) e modelos de simulação de eventos discretos. Você será a ponte entre a engenharia industrial e a tomada de decisão estratégica, testando cenários virtuais para otimizar o fluxo de produção, reduzir gargalos e validar novos investimentos antes que eles saiam do papel.

Requisitos e Qualificações

O que você precisa ter (Essencial)

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Controle e Automação) ou Ciência da Computação / áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência prática com o Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation.
  • Domínio de programação em SimTalk.
  • Conhecimento forte em Estatística aplicada à simulação (distribuições de probabilidade, validação de dados de entrada e análise de saída).

Estamos na busca de profissionais para compor a nossa equipe!

Faça seu cadastro e envie seu currículo!

  • Receber o plantão e acompanhar a programação das atividades, verificar os materiais de trabalho e a distribuição das tarefas para a equipe técnica, checar os registros no mapa diário, tomando as devidas providências para solucionar as pendências;

  • Realizar aprazamento de prescrição médica e administrar medicações;
  • Estabelecer prioridades e orientar a equipe na qualidade da assistência de enfermagem;
  • Realizar a sistematização da assistência de enfermagem;
  • Preparar os clientes para realizarem exames e/ou transferências, quando necessário;
  • Realizar atividades administrativas relativas à solicitação de autorização de exames, agendamentos de exames, transferência de pacientes para UTI ou enfermaria, e outros;
  • Contatar médicos de sobreaviso e /ou especialistas, quando necessário;
  • Monitorar e garantir a utilização de Equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs);
  • Preencher o livro de ocorrência;
  • Registrar no Prontuário eletrônico do paciente (PEP) o histórico de enfermagem, com evolução diária e prescrição médica dos pacientes;
  • Reportar ao enfermeiro líder ou coordenador os resultados do setor, propondo melhorias para o alcance das metas estabelecidas;

  • Acompanhar o recebimento de medicamentos nas unidades;
  • Supervisionar e atuar nos programas de controle sistemático de infecção hospitalar;
  • Manter contato com profissionais de outros setores, sempre que necessário, para alinhamento de processos e procedimentos;
  • Seguir e monitorar a aplicação do Protocolo operacional padrão (POP), sugerindo melhoria nos processos, quando possível;
  • Participar periodicamente de reuniões com a equipe de enfermagem;
  • Planejar ações de melhorias, levantando as necessidades e estabelecendo prioridades para resolução;
  • Capacitar e promover treinamentos em serviço “in-loco” com a equipe de enfermagem;
  • Participar do processo de capacitação, educação permanente e avaliação de desempenho dos profissionais;
  • Contribuir e/ou desenvolver ações de melhoria ao programa de qualidade e segurança no atendimento ao cliente;
  • Verificar o uso e funcionamento dos equipamentos, solicitar manutenção e reparo sempre que necessário, garantindo perfeitas condições de uso;
  • Manter o ambiente de trabalho tranquilo e organizado, verificando a disponibilidade do material necessário, a funcionalidade dos equipamentos, a utilização das vestimentas e indumentárias, a limpeza e a qualidade da assistência de enfermagem aos pacientes e familiares;
  • Manter-se atualizado acerca das tendências técnicas e científicas no campo administrativo e da sua especialidade, bem como no campo das mudanças legais referentes ao COREN, Ministério da Saúde, ANVISA e outras esferas importantes;
  • Cumprir às normas, procedimentos ou instruções de trabalho, conforme sua área de atuação, estabelecidos pela empresa ou legislação em vigor.

Requisitos necessários

  • Superior completo em Enfermagem;
  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN).
  • Especialização na área

O que oferecemos?

  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Parcerias e descontos com Instituições de Ensino;
  • TotalPass (parceria com academias);
  • Plano de Carreira.

Há 80 anos, oferecemos o melhor para cumprir a nossa missão de proporcionar saúde integrada de qualidade e acessível a gerações de brasileiros. Cuidamos com qualidade do bem-estar das pessoas de forma séria, comprometida e socialmente responsável, somando as melhores práticas para oferecer saúde acessível e de qualidade à população brasileira.

Temos o compromisso de promover a diversidade e a inclusão no local de trabalho. Nossos objetivos são pautados na construção de um ambiente livre de preconceitos, discriminação, assédio moral e sexual, desrespeito, injustiça ou condutas ofensivas. Além disso, buscamos criar um ambiente onde todos se sintam seguros para expressar quem realmente são, com igualdade e equidade de oportunidades.

Incentivamos a candidatura de todas as pessoas que se sintam alinhadas ao nosso compromisso de diversidade e à nossa missão de tornar saúde de qualidade acessível aos brasileiros.

title: Automation & Integration Engineer
description:
ContentJet is a Canadian UGC creative agency that connects brands with creators to produce high-performing user-generated content at scale. Our delivery engine runs entirely on AI automation and intelligent integration infrastructure. Every AI agent, content pipeline, and creator workflow we operate depends on rock-solid automation plumbing. Our philosophy is simple: if a human is doing it manually and it’s repetitive, it should be automated. Period.

THE MISSION: BUILD THE INFRASTRUCTURE THAT ELIMINATES MANUAL WORK

Every AI agent and automation at ContentJet needs reliable infrastructure to run. You are the person who builds and maintains that infrastructure — the n8n workflows, API integrations, webhook flows, data pipelines, and server management that keep our AI-powered operations running 24/7 without human babysitting.

Your work directly enables the replacement of manual tasks: when the AI Agent Architect builds a creator sourcing agent, you build the n8n workflow that feeds it data and routes its outputs. When a new content pipeline is designed, you wire up the APIs (ElevenLabs, Creatomate, Metricool, Google Veo) and make sure it runs reliably at scale. When OpenClaw agents need to be deployed and maintained, you handle the infrastructure.

THE ROLE

You are the engine room of ContentJet’s AI operations. Every AI agent we build — whether deployed through OpenClaw, orchestrated via Claude Cowork, or built with Claude Code CLI — needs reliable execution infrastructure. You own the entire execution and integration layer.

You will use Claude Code CLI to rapidly build and debug integration scripts, custom n8n nodes, and data transformation logic. You will leverage Claude Cowork with MCP connectors when orchestrating complex multi-platform data flows that require intelligent routing. You will maintain the OpenClaw gateway infrastructure that keeps our agents accessible across Slack, Telegram, and web.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build and maintain complex n8n workflows that power creator pipelines, content production, outreach automation, and internal operations — replacing manual copy-paste, data entry, and coordination tasks
  • Use Claude Code CLI to rapidly develop custom integration scripts, n8n function nodes, data transformation logic, and debugging tools
  • Support Claude Cowork‑orchestrated workflows by building the underlying API connections and data pipelines that MCP connectors rely on
  • Connect and orchestrate APIs: ElevenLabs, Google Veo 3.1, Creatomate, Metricool, Instantly, Apollo, Modash, TikTok, Monday.com, Slack, Google Drive, and more
  • Manage self-hosted infrastructure (n8n on VPS, OpenClaw deployments) — including deployment, updates, credential management, SSL, and troubleshooting
  • Support OpenClaw gateway infrastructure: ensure uptime, manage agent configurations, troubleshoot connectivity and tool availability issues across Slack/Telegram deployments
  • Build webhook-based integrations between AI agents (deployed via OpenClaw or standalone) and external platforms
  • Design error handling, retry logic, dead letter queues, and monitoring for production workflows and agent deployments
  • Optimize existing automation pipelines for speed, cost, and reliability (e.g., finance news video pipeline V7→V8+, creator outreach flows, content publishing automations)
  • Build automated reporting and notification systems that replace manual status updates and check‑ins
  • Handle data transformation, formatting, and routing between systems — ensuring clean data flow across the entire automation stack
  • Maintain and improve the infrastructure layer that supports the AI Agent Architect’s deployments
  • Continuously identify integration bottlenecks and manual handoffs that can be automated away

MUST‑HAVE SKILLS

  • n8n expertise (self-hosted is a must — not just cloud) — you can build complex multi-branch workflows with error handling, retries, and conditional logic
  • Claude Code CLI proficiency — comfortable using Claude as a coding partner to rapidly build integration scripts, debug issues, and develop custom solutions from the terminal
  • Webhook architecture: designing, securing, and debugging complex webhook flows across multiple platforms
  • Basic Linux/VPS administration: SSH, systemd, file management, logs, cron jobs, process monitoring
  • Experience with Docker (containerized deployments, docker‑compose) — critical for managing OpenClaw and self-hosted services
  • Database basics: SQLite, PostgreSQL — enough to troubleshoot persistence issues, run queries, and manage credential stores
  • Understanding of MCP (Model Context Protocol) — how Claude Cowork connects to external tools and how to build/maintain those connections

NICE‑TO‑HAVE

  • Experience with Claude Cowork and MCP connector workflows
  • Experience deploying and managing OpenClaw or similar AI agent gateways in production
  • Experience with Make (Integromat) or Zapier in addition to n8n
  • Familiarity with video/audio APIs: ElevenLabs, Creatomate, HeyGen, Google Veo 3.1
  • Experience with email automation platforms (Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist)
  • Knowledge of CI/CD, monitoring tools (Uptime Kuma, Grafana), or logging stacks
  • Familiarity with Slack API, Monday.com API, Telegram Bot API, or similar workspace/platform tools
  • Background in UGC, creator operations, or content production workflows
  • French or Arabic language skills

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within 30 days: You’ve audited and stabilized our existing n8n workflows, VPS infrastructure, and OpenClaw deployment, fixing known issues. You’re using Claude Code CLI daily to debug and ship fixes fast.

Within 60 days: You’re independently building new automation workflows for client and creator projects using n8n and Claude Code CLI. You’ve implemented monitoring for our OpenClaw gateway and critical production workflows. At least 5 manual processes have been replaced with automated pipelines.

Within 90 days: You’re managing 10+ concurrent production workflows, our infrastructure runs at 99%+ uptime, and you’re the go‑to person for all integration, deployment, and infrastructure work. Manual data handling and coordination tasks are effectively eliminated from ContentJet’s daily operations.

Automation & Integration Engineer • Salvador, BR

title: Technical Ai Project Manager / Qa Lead
description:
ContentJet is a Canadian UGC creative agency that connects brands with creators to produce high-performing user-generated content at scale. We serve global clients across e-commerce, healthcare, and marketing verticals.

Our core belief: every manual, repetitive task inside an agency can and should be replaced by an AI agent or automation. We use Claude Code CLI, Claude Cowork with MCP connectors, OpenClaw, n8n, VAPI, and custom multi-agent systems to eliminate manual work across every layer of our operations — from creator sourcing and outreach to content production, team coordination, and client delivery.

THE MISSION: SHIELD OPERATIONS AND PERFECT THE AI DEPLOYMENTS

ContentJet is undergoing a massive transformation to become a fully AI-native agency. While our AI Agent Architect and Automation Engineer build the complex infrastructure, we need a ruthless tester and operational bridge.

Your mission is simple: ensure that no buggy agent, broken n8n workflow, or hallucinating AI ever reaches the CEO, our team, or our clients. You are the ultimate gatekeeper of quality and the translator between our agency operations and our engineering pod.

THE ROLE

You are the operational anchor of our AI transformation. You will not be writing the Python code or building the complex multi-agent architectures, but you must be technical enough to understand how they work, how they connect via APIs, and exactly how they break.

You will audit our existing manual operations, write clear documentation detailing exactly what the AI needs to do, and hand those requirements to the engineering team. Once they build an agent (deployed via OpenClaw) or an automation (via n8n), your job is to try to break it. You will test every edge case, log every bug, and manage the feedback loop until the system is bulletproof and ready for the agency floor.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Audit and Document: Deep-dive into our current agency operations, mapping out every manual click, copy-paste, and email to create clear requirements for the AI Architect.
  • Relentless QA & Testing: Act as the "human-in-the-loop" during the testing phase. You will vigorously test AI agents across Slack, Monday.com, and web interfaces to find edge cases, hallucinations, and logic failures before deployment.
  • Bug Reporting & Triage: Manage the development pipeline. When a VAPI voice agent fails a creator screening or an n8n webhook drops data, you write the detailed bug report for the engineering team.
  • Prompt QA: Review the outputs of AI workflows (such as personalized creator briefs or automated emails) to ensure the tone, accuracy, and brand alignment are perfect.
  • Protect the CEO: Fully own the testing and troubleshooting phase so the CEO can focus purely on running the agency, completely removed from software QA.
  • Team Training: Once an AI agent or automation is finalized, you will write the standard operating procedures (SOPs) and train the ContentJet staff on how to use the new system.

MUST-HAVE SKILLS

  • Exceptional QA Experience: You have a proven track record of testing complex software, automations, or AI workflows and documenting bugs clearly.
  • Technical Literacy: While you aren't writing production Python, you understand how APIs work, what webhooks are, and the basics of n8n and LLM prompt logic. You know why systems break.
  • Hyper-Organization: You are a master of project management tools (Monday.com, Jira, Linear) and can manage multiple concurrent AI deployments without dropping the ball.
  • UGC / Agency Understanding: You understand how a creative agency functions—what a creator brief is, how outreach works, and the level of quality clients expect.
  • Flawless English Communication: You will be writing detailed technical tickets, testing client-facing AI outputs, and writing internal training guides.

NICE-TO-HAVE

  • Previous experience working in an AI startup or working directly alongside AI Engineers.
  • Hands-on experience with Monday.com, n8n, or testing chatbot/agent outputs.
  • Background in UGC, creator operations, or content production workflows.
  • Aligned with North American time zones (EST/PST).

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Within 30 days: You have fully audited our top 5 manual workflows, created a clear roadmap for the engineering pod, and established a formalized bug-reporting and testing system.
  • Within 60 days: You are rigorously testing the first wave of deployed AI agents. You have successfully caught, documented, and helped resolve critical edge cases before they impacted agency staff.
  • Within 90 days: You completely own the AI product lifecycle. The CEO is entirely removed from all QA and troubleshooting, and manual work across the agency is rapidly decreasing thanks to your smooth deployments.

Acompanhar e atender diariamente as solicitações realizadas e geradas via sistema Mobuss Construções, controlando desde a abertura até o encerramento, apropriações, checklists, inspeções e outros.

Realizar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva de quadros de distribuição, quadros de comando, iluminação, rede, força, aterramento, motores elétricos.

Garantir a confiabilidade das instalações elétricas prediais por meio da realização de testes e manutenção.

Identificar causas de falhas nas instalações elétricas, corrigindo os defeitos associados.

Vistoriar instalações novas e antigas, para verificar se estão dentro das normas e se estão funcionando corretamente.

Segurança e Organização:

Realizar conservação e limpeza ao término de todas as tarefas, seguindo os procedimentos de trabalho e segurança.

Respeitar as regras e princípios de SMS (Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Saúde) do Terminal, através do cumprimento dos procedimentos de SMS.

Aplicar normas de segurança do trabalho (NR-10) em todas as atividades, utilizando equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) e coletiva (EPCs).

Garantir a segurança das instalações elétricas, prevenindo riscos de acidentes e incêndios.

Levantamento de materiais para execução de serviços.

Fazer registro fotográfico antes, durante e depois das atividades, emissão de relatórios.

Elaborar relatórios sobre as atividades realizadas.

Substituir e reparar componentes elétricos danificados.

Logística:

Realizar transporte de materiais utilizando veículo da empresa, respeitando legislações e normas.

Outras atribuições:

Colaborar com outros profissionais da área de manutenção, como pedreiros, encanadores e técnicos de ar condicionado.

Comunicar-se de forma clara e eficiente com os superiores e colegas de trabalho.

Engenheiro de Dados Júnior

Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.

Responsabilidades diárias

  • Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
  • Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
  • Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;

  • Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;

Mais do que atender, esperamos que esse profissional tenha condições de assumir o setor com seriedade, enxergar falhas, antecipar necessidades, apoiar melhorias e se tornar uma referência interna em postura, organização e capacidade de resolução.

Somos uma plataforma que ajuda investidores a encontrarem as melhores oportunidades de investimentos. Temos como base a filosofia Buy And Hold (Investimento de longo prazo). Trazemos para nossos usuários informações como: cotações, balanços, comparadores, históricos financeiros das empresas, gráficos, cursos, gerenciador de carteiras, entre outras funcionalidades. Lançada em dezembro de 2020, a plataforma vem tendo um ótimo crescimento, mensalmente já são mais de 18 milhões de pageviews acessadas.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Designer Sênior com conhecimento em UX e foco em UI para elevar a experiência visual dos nossos produtos digitais. Você será responsável por transformar ideias em interfaces funcionais, consistentes e visualmente impecáveis — garantindo que design e negócio caminhem juntos. Procuramos alguém com olhar estético apurado, pensamento sistêmico e domínio técnico em design de interface, que entenda profundamente de sistemas de design, usabilidade e consistência visual em escala.

Escopo de atividades:

  • Desenhar interfaces digitais completas (web e mobile) com atenção a detalhes, consistência e acessibilidade.
  • Traduzir fluxos e requisitos de produto em soluções visuais escaláveis, dentro do design system.
  • Criar e evoluir componentes, padrões visuais e guidelines em colaboração com a área de Produto e de Tecnologia.
  • Garantir a qualidade visual e coerência entre plataformas (web, iOS, Android).
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com Product Managers e Engineers desde a concepção até a entrega.
  • Colaborar com a gestão com relação: wireframes e protótipos, adicionando clareza, hierarquia e emoção visual.
  • Participar de rituais de produto e trazer um olhar das boas práticas de design centrado no usuário.
  • Monitorar tendências de UI, motion e design systems para manter o produto atualizado e competitivo.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência em Product Design ou UI Design em empresas digitais, startups ou scale-ups.
  • Experiência prática em design systems e bibliotecas compartilhadas.
  • Entendimento de boas práticas de front-end (HTML, CSS, responsividade) para colaborar com devs.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

Diferenciais:

  • Olhar crítico e alto padrão estético — “good taste + usability sense”.
  • Comunicação clara e empática com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Mentalidade de produto: entende métricas, trade-offs e impacto de design no negócio.
  • Organização e ownership: cuida do design system e documenta decisões.
  • Curiosidade e atualização constante sobre tendências visuais, tipografia e acessibilidade.
  • Perfil: resiliente, colaborativo e resolutivo.

Informações Complementares:

  • Ambiente de trabalho agradável e organizado;
  • Trabalho 100% Remoto;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Contrato: Prestador de Serviços (PJ) com pacote completo de benefícios.

About the job Partner with PEAK Camps(Switzerland)

About PEAK Camps

Peak Tennis International is redefining what a tennis camp can be. We’re empowering young people and players to discover their Peak Potential through world-class tennis and golf coaching, holistic wellness practices, and transformative personal development.

Our locations span three countries :

Eton College, UK – Royal elite facilities with 40+ courts and sports facilities

Leysin, Switzerland - Stunning Alpine setting at 1,260m altitude

Tainach, Austria - Lakeside training with breathwork & wellness integration

With campers from 30+ countries and a philosophy that celebrates growth over competition, we’re entering an exciting expansion phase, and we’re looking for passionate partners to grow with us.

The Opportunity : Educational Agent & School Partnership Program

We’re seeking educational advisers, agents, and schools worldwide to join our partnership network and help families discover the PEAK experience.

What Makes This Different?

Global Reach, Local Impact - Represent premium international camps that combine sports excellence with mindfulness, breathwork, nutrition, and life skills development, programs parents actively seek for their children’s holistic growth.

Attractive Commission Structure - Earn competitive commission on total program fees :

Eton College (UK) : 5,990 CHF per camper

Switzerland : 2,500-4,500 CHF per camper

First-Mover Advantage - 2026 is our breakthrough international year. Join us on the ground floor as we scale to 200+ camp seats annually and expand into the Brazilian, US, and Middle Eastern markets.

Partnership, Not Just Commission - You’ll work directly with our team and receive full marketing support, detailed program materials, and ongoing communication throughout the customer journey.

What We’re Looking For

Ideal Partners

  • Educational agents & advisers with established networks of families seeking international summer programs
  • International schools interested in offering enrichment opportunities to students
  • Sports academies & tennis clubs looking to provide premium camp experiences
  • Study abroad consultants who work with families valuing holistic education
  • Independent coaches with extensive networks of families and children.

You’ll Thrive If You

  • Have existing relationships with the families of young children and teenagers.
  • Understand the value of experiential learning and personal development
  • Are comfortable promoting premium educational experiences (our camps are all-inclusive investment programs)
  • Can communicate in multiple languages (our campers come from 30+ countries)
  • Are self-motivated and entrepreneurial, as this is a commission-based partnership
  • Believe in the transformative power of sport, wellness, and community

Why Partner with PEAK Camps?

Proven Excellence - Founded in 2016 by Regina Sertschnigg, an internationally certified Swiss Tennis Coach, with partnerships including the Swiss Tennis Organisation.

Small Ratios, Big Impact - 1 : 4 coach-to-player ratio ensures personalized attention and measurable growth.

Holistic Development - Beyond sports : breathwork with mindset coaches, ice baths for mental resilience, nutrition education, physiotherapy, and personal development workshops.

Safety & Quality First - 24-hour supervision, on-site medical support, comprehensive insurance, and staff certified to work with children across all locations.

Social Impact – We are a crucial part of the support of Project Zambia, our foundation that provides tennis and education to children in Zambia.

What You’ll Receive

  • Dedicated partner support - Direct line to our business development team
  • CRM access - Track your referrals and commissions transparently
  • Co-marketing opportunities - We’ll amplify your efforts through our channels
  • Competitive commission structure - Earn on every successful enrolment
  • Early access to new programs - Be first to know about expansion locations and offerings

How It Works

  1. Apply - Share your background and network reach
  2. Onboarding - Receive full program training and marketing materials
  3. Promote - Connect families with PEAK Camps through your and our channels
  4. Earn - Receive commission on every confirmed enrolment
  5. Grow Together - Scale your partnership as we expand globally

Join Our Mission

At PEAK Camps, every young person deserves the chance to discover their potential, and it doesn’t matter if it is on the court or in life. Our motto, Peak Potential. Peak You, was created as a commitment to personal growth, resilience, and community. If you’re an educational professional who shares our vision and wants to build a meaningful, profitable partnership promoting world-class development programs, we want to hear from you.

Ready to Partner?

Contact : Learn More :

Based in : Leysin, Switzerland (with camps in the UK, Switzerland & Austria)

Application Process : Send us a brief introduction, including :

  • Your background in education / student advising
  • Geographic regions and networks you serve
  • Why you’re interested in partnering with PEAK Camps
  • Any relevant experience with international programs or sports camps

Peak Tennis International is an equal opportunity partner. We welcome educational professionals from all backgrounds who share our commitment to people development and holistic education.

description:
Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in‑class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership‑first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo’s 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7‑10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high‑quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on‑time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day‑to‑day contact for retention marketing across 7‑10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi‑weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end‑to‑end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on‑time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on‑site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management

Requirements

  • 3‑5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert‑level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5‑10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service‑oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices

Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue

Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work‑life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help one of our enterprise clients unlock the value of their data for AI-driven use cases. The goal focus for this role is to "make the data AI-ready": well-structured, semantically rich, documented, and governed.

Your primary output is a clean, well-documented, and semantically meaningful data environment that downstream AI workloads can reason over reliably.

What You Will Do

Semantic Modeling

  • Work with Databricks semantic layer to expose curated datasets for AI and analytics consumption

Data Documentation and Context

  • Establish lineage tracing from source system tables through to consumption-ready datasets
  • Collaborate with source systems stakeholders to capture domain knowledge and translate it into structured metadata

AI Readiness

  • Structure data to support LLM-based and ML workloads, including RAG pipelines and structured querying
  • Identify and address data quality gaps that would undermine AI model reliability
  • Define thematic data domains and organize datasets to give AI systems the right context and scope

Governance and Quality

  • Implement data quality rules and freshness monitors using Databricks tooling
  • Tag sensitive fields and support data access tier definitions within Unity Catalog
  • Own documentation standards and ensure the catalog remains accurate as data evolves

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering, data architecture, or a closely related discipline
  • Hands‑on Databricks expertise: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, cluster configuration, and query optimization
  • Experience with semantic modeling tools, ideally dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud)
  • Strong SQL and a solid understanding of data modeling patterns (star schema, medallion architecture, etc.)
  • Ability to read and interpret unfamiliar data models quickly, including ERP-sourced data structures
  • Experience writing technical documentation that non-technical stakeholders can act on

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Databricks AI/BI, Genie, or Vector Search
  • Experience supporting ML or LLM-based downstream use cases

title: Credit Risk Analyst -Consumer Lending
description:
Credit Risk Analyst - Consumer Lending

300 Software • Salvador, BR

300 Software · Remote (Brazil) · Full-time | PJ

Before you read further: this is NOT an FP&A, Treasury, Controller, corporate credit, or FIDC role. If your background is primarily in those areas, this position is a different discipline and will likely not be a good fit.

Our US fintech client — an online consumer lender — is looking for a Credit Risk Analyst who owns the front end of the credit funnel: designing risk tiers, sequencing underwriting decisions, managing approval/decline trade-offs, and building the logic that determines who gets credit and at what terms. If you have hands‑on experience with risk tiers, underwriting decision paths, dynamic acquisition pricing, or rescue lane strategies at an online lender, BNPL provider, or fintech — this role is built for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own and iterate credit acquisition policies inside an automated decisioning engine
  • Build and validate scorecards; monitor performance through vintage analysis and population stability
  • Segment applicants by acquisition channel, product, and risk tier — and price accordingly
  • Identify emerging fraud patterns and respond with targeted policy changes
  • Work cross-functionally with US product and marketing teams to balance growth and risk
  • Write SQL to investigate, model, and monitor — no waiting on a data team

Requirements (Non Negotiable)

  • 3+ years of experience in online consumer lending, BNPL, or a tangential fintech/e-commerce credit environment
  • Hands-on acquisition/top-of-funnel risk experience: risk tier assessment, underwriting sequencing, or dynamic acquisition pricing
  • Fluent English — interviews, daily standups, and all written communication are in English
  • SQL proficiency — comfortable writing queries independently to analyze credit performance data

Nice to Have

  • Experience with rescue lane management or near‑miss recovery programs
  • Background in fraud risk within the acquisition funnel
  • Exposure to multi-path underwriting logic or decision engine configuration
  • Portfolio monitoring and credit loss forecasting (post‑acquisition)
  • Experience at an e-commerce, marketplace lending, or embedded finance company

What We Offer

  • PJ/contractor arrangement — compensation aligned with fintech market rates
  • 100% remote — work from anywhere in Brazil
  • US Central Time schedule — structured workday, no late nights
  • Direct exposure to a fast‑growing US online lending operation

Quick Self-Screen

In your last role: were the majority of credit decisions made automatically, within seconds, for individual consumers (not companies)? If yes — we'd like to talk. If your process involved credit committees, manual case‑by‑case review, or business borrowers — this is a different kind of role, and it's worth being honest about that upfront.

title: Backend Go Developer (Replay-Api)
description:
Replay API / LeetGaming.pro (Brazil-based, fully open-source core)

Role Summary

As a Backend Go Developer, you will design, build, and scale the core Go backend that powers LeetGaming.pro’s Replay API — the engine behind AI-driven game replay analysis, matchmaking, tournaments, and player performance evaluation for competitive titles (CS2, Valorant, and more). You will work directly on parsing massive volumes of replay files, storing and querying structured data, running background workers, and delivering secure, high-performance REST/RPC/WebSocket APIs that serve gamers, teams, and tournament organizers worldwide.

What Success Looks Like

  • You ship production-ready features (new game parsers, event handlers, scoring systems, or ML integrations) that are fast, reliable, and easy to maintain.
  • The platform scales smoothly as replay volume grows, with clean code, comprehensive tests, and zero-downtime deployments via Docker + Kubernetes.
  • You actively contribute to the open-source repository, improve architecture and security (including post-quantum cryptography), and help the team move from prototype to production launch.
  • Stakeholders (founders, esports partners, and players) see tangible improvements in data accuracy, query speed, and new capabilities like MMR wallets or AI talent scoring.

How This Role Fits into the Organization

Replay API is the central backend of LeetGaming.pro. Your work directly enables the entire product: every replay upload, match analysis, tournament bracket, and player insight flows through the services you build. You will collaborate closely with the small, high-impact team (currently led by the project’s main contributor) and influence the product roadmap while keeping the entire stack open-source under MIT.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement RESTful APIs, RPC endpoints, and secure WebSocket services in Go to handle replay ingestion, search, and real-time event streaming.
  • Develop and optimize replay parsers and background workers (OCR, oracle, game-discovery, etc.) that extract player actions, statistics, and events from multiple game formats.
  • Model, store, and query large-scale replay data using MongoDB with efficient indexing, aggregation pipelines, and the repository pattern.
  • Build and maintain matchmaking, tournament, MMR, and Solana wallet integration logic.
  • Integrate and expose machine-learning models that evaluate player performance and generate talent scores.
  • Ensure high availability and scalability by containerizing services with Docker and deploying on Kubernetes.
  • Write unit/integration tests, enforce code quality with golangci-lint, and participate in CI/CD pipelines that publish images to GitHub Container Registry.
  • Harden security (RID token auth, post-quantum cryptography, input validation) across all services.
  • Document APIs (OpenAPI) and contribute to architecture decisions and Jira backlog.
  • Collaborate with the open-source community by reviewing pull requests and following the project’s contributing guidelines.

Qualifications

Required

  • Strong proficiency in Go (1.16+; 1.23+ preferred) with experience building production backend services.
  • Hands‑on experience with MongoDB (or comparable NoSQL databases) and designing performant data models.
  • Solid understanding of REST, RPC, and WebSocket APIs.
  • Experience with Docker for containerization and basic Kubernetes deployment knowledge.
  • Comfortable writing tests and following clean‑code practices (linting, modular architecture).

Preferred

  • Previous work with game replay parsing, binary data formats, or large‑scale data processing pipelines.
  • Familiarity with event‑driven systems, background workers, or microservices.
  • Exposure to machine‑learning model integration or analytics platforms.
  • Interest or experience in esports, competitive gaming, matchmaking systems, or blockchain/Solana integrations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (not required).
  • Located in Brazil or available for overlapping hours with a Brazil‑based team.

Nice-to-Have

  • Contributions to open‑source Go projects.
  • Knowledge of post‑quantum cryptography or advanced security practices.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, Jira, or similar tools used by the team.

What We Offer

  • Direct impact on an open‑source product that is shaping the future of competitive gaming analytics.
  • Work alongside a small, passionate team that values quality code and rapid iteration.
  • Flexible remote setup with Brazil‑friendly hours.
  • Opportunity to grow into senior/lead roles as the platform expands.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga

unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

Quem somos nós?

Somos a JDE Peet’s. Nós produzimos um café para cada xícara e desenvolvemos marcas para cada coração.

A JDE Peet’s é a principal empresa global dedicada exclusivamente ao café, servindo aproximadamente 4.400 xícaras de café por segundo em mais de 100 mercados. Em 2024, a JDE Peet’s gerou 8,8 bilhões de euros em vendas e contava com mais de 21 mil colaboradores no mundo todo.

No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.

Acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor de uma xícara de café.
Juntos, criamos esses momentos todos os dias, transformando ideias em impacto e possibilidades em realidade. Na JDE Peet’s, trabalhamos como um só time, guiados por nossos valores: Ouse Encantar, Seja Dono, Simplifique e Vencer Juntos. Aqui, você encontra liberdade para inovar, coragem para dar passos ousados e apoio para desenvolver sua carreira em um ambiente global.

Como Engenheiro(a) de Software Principal na equipe de Administração de Membros dentro das soluções de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção da Autodesk, você será responsável por orientar a equipe de engenharia e liderar o design técnico para construir funcionalidades que preparem nossos clientes para o sucesso no Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).

A equipe de Administração de Membros é responsável por fornecer aos clientes do ACC ferramentas para gerenciar usuários e permissões de hubs e projetos. Trabalhamos diretamente com nossos clientes para oferecer soluções para alguns de seus maiores desafios em gestão de construção. Você desempenhará um papel crítico em transformar essas soluções em realidade.

O ACC melhora a gestão da construção e capacita todos os construtores com equipes conectadas, fluxos de trabalho e dados por meio de uma plataforma onde os usuários podem interagir de forma fluida e eficiente ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida da construção. Estamos construindo o futuro do software de construção.
